snippet.title: Beetle in the Anthill — The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
snippet.description:
This video shows the Beetle in the Anthill mission from The Expanse: Osiris Reborn and a female Martian protagonist. You and your sister J disguise yourselves as members of the mysterious Osiris branch of Protogen to infiltrate the secret base of the organization on Ganymede. But things don't go according to plan, and you have to fight for your lives, being chased by an unknown monster as you try to reunite with your crew.
